golden_reference.rule: Permanent visual reference. Do not redesign or creatively reconstruct.

benchmark_rules.source_priority: Primary/official source preferred; secondary source only when necessary and clearly identified.
benchmark_rules.unit_integrity: Never mix live-weight and carcass-weight quotations.

status_model.VERIFIED: Numeric benchmark verified from an acceptable current source.
status_model.NQ: Official benchmark/publication exists but no numeric quotation was formulated (e.g. NON FORMULATO).

locked_visual_rules.wrapping: mandatory inside each panel; no overlap

definition_of_done: Render only with EU_PORK_MARKET_RENDERER.py using the locked Golden Reference.
Perform visual QA: no overlap, clipping or panel overflow.
PASS only after deterministic render and visual QA succeed.
execution_integrity: Never claim VERIFIED, PASS, executed, updated or created without tool/source evidence.
obsolete_files: Older contract, hotfix, mask-map, dataset-template, manifest and intermediate WK38 images are not required in active LUMI Knowledge after these 3 canonical files are installed.
